messages:
sarah_support: heads-up — acme-corp (org_id: org_01A2B3) pinged support, says their embedding requests all started returning 403s about 30m ago. customer pasted response body that just says `{
  \"error\": {\"message\": \"API key invalid\"}}` so they're convinced the key is revoked. ticket #INC-1829.

eli_agent: thanks — can you paste a raw curl + request-id if they have one? also need the precise endpoint (embeddings vs text).

sarah_support: they sent this repro (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED(ab12)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-2","input":"hello"}'
```
response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
body: `{"error":{"message":"API key invalid"}}`
request-id: req_7f8c4a9b

tim_ops: grabbing logs for req_7f8c4a9b. quick note: we recently changed entitlement checks so they run before token introspection for some routes — that might produce ambiguous messages if upstream mapping is wrong.

deploy-bot: deployment 2025-03-12/entitlement-gating-v2 rolled at 10:04 UTC (sha: b4c3d).

eli_agent: tim — what do logs show for that request id? entitlement service response body/code?

tim_ops: logs: `2025-03-12T10:22:14Z req=req_7f8c4a9b auth=sk-REDACTED status=403 component=entitlement service_response={"code":"ENTITLEMENT_MISSING","feature":"embeddings"}` — note: runtime returned generic 403 with message 'API key invalid' when entitlement denied. sending full trace to thread.

eli_agent: aha. so this is a UX/mapping problem: entitlement service is correctly blocking (customer plan doesn't include embeddings) but the runtime maps ENTITLEMENT_MISSING -> generic auth message which misleads customers.

maria_pm: customer says they just upgraded their card yesterday — billing console shows invoice pending. billing-bot, can you confirm plan state?

billing-bot: org_01A2B3 plan: Starter (no embeddings entitlement). latest invoice: INV-9002 status: unpaid. trial credit used up. For testing we can grant temporary entitlement via internal CLI: `rbilling grant-entitlement --org org_01A2B3 --feature embeddings --ttl 24h` (requires billing-admin).

eli_agent: recommended next steps for support: 1) don't ask the customer to rotate keys yet (this won't help), 2) explain it's a plan entitlement issue and share the exact error code, 3) if they need immediate access provide a 24h trial via billing-admin or suggest upgrade flow. can we also change the API error text to include an entitlement code so customers aren't confused?

sarah_support: forwarding to customer: "We're seeing a plan-level entitlement block (code: ENTITLEMENT_MISSING) — not an API key revocation. If you want immediate access we can provision a 24-hour trial while you resolve invoice issues." :+1:

eli_agent: I'll file a runtime bug — map entitlement failures to 403 with clear message and code, e.g., `{"error":{"code":"ENTITLEMENT_MISSING","message":"Your plan does not include embeddings. See /account/plan"}}`. tagging eng-runtime.

eli_agent: CC @tim_ops @deploy-bot — is this a quick fix or needs migration? we shouldn't be shipping ambiguous auth messages.

tim_ops: it's a small mapping change in the gateway layer; patch + canary deploy should be fine. estimate: 2-3 dev-hours and a 1-hour canary. will add a guard in logs to include entitlement.code in response headers `X-Entitlement-Code` for easier diagnosis.

deploy-bot: canary schedule: 2025-03-12T13:00 UTC -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% if healthy. rollback window 30m.

maria_pm: also propose adding a short blurb in billing emails when plan features are gated so customers see "Embeddings disabled on Starter plan". customer-facing docs ticket opened.

eli_agent: next actions: (1) billing-admin to grant test entitlement to org_01A2B3 (sarah will request), (2) tim to patch mapping and add X-Entitlement-Code header, (3) eng to roll canary, (4) support to update customer with correct reason and steps. I'll track in INC-1829.

sarah_support: billing-admin request submitted (portal case #BILL-314). I'll follow up on this thread once they confirm grant. leaving note to not rotate API keys. :slightly_smiling_face:

maria_pm: long term: we should avoid exposing a generic "API key invalid" string anywhere — misleading and spikes support load. logging that as product action item (P-1287).

eli_agent: thanks team. I'll update INC-1829 with timeline and post once canary is live.
